note: Generated data for the Conflux Elemental Fusion units (user design 2026-11-15). Stats are derived at build time from the final parent rows (tools/release_port/homm3_conflux_fusion_core_overlay.py): HP = sum, damage min/max = round(0.9 x sum), Attack/Defense = higher parent + 1, Initiative/Speed/movement = faster parent, attacks = host's. 'mesh': null keeps the host parent's mesh/mapMesh; set {"mesh": ..., "mapMesh": ...} to swap in a fused model. 'signature': null keeps both parents' kits; a signature replaces both parents' actives (kind active) or passives (kind passive); build 'fallback' keeps both kits.

signature.notes: Melee ability attack at 100% basic damage (attack_single_x100, normal damage) plus push_unit_from_caster. Damage is the fused unit's own basic attack, so no dealerPatch. Donor envelope kept.

Self buff qilin_selfbuff for 1 round: stats maxInDmg 1 and ignoreObstacles true. The code fills in the per-hit cap shown as {0}, and I could not resolve it from data (it is maxInDmg 1). That is why the vanilla card text is kept and no number is written. Free action.

signature.reason: Runtime-only. h3_jotunn has no logic passive for it (only the view card h3_common_passive_bulwark_flyer_slow_name); Homm3BulwarkUnitAbilityRuntime applies homm3_bulwark_frostbound_skies_speed_1/_2 (-1/-2 Speed, infinite) to enemy flyers at Unit.Init, keyed on a hard-coded jotunn sid list. No data trigger here can filter enemy flyers at battle start.
signature.notes: Buff rows exist (speed_1 = -1 Speed); adding the fused sid to the runtime's sid list would be a plugin change, outside this spec.

signature.descriptionText: Strikes twice when performing attacks.
signature.notes: Double Strike is not a stat: it is a logic passive {data.sequenceEffect}. Melee units use 'add_attack_after_counter_melee' (locust/esquire_upg passives[0]); shooters use 'add_attack_after_counter_shoot' (h3_archer_upg/crossbowman_upg passives[0]). Host h3_water_elemental_upg_alt is a shooter, so the shoot row is primary; if the fused default attack is melee, use altLogicPassives (locust:passives:0) instead. Do not graft both (single sequenceEffect slot).

signature.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to prevent target enemy creature from using Ranged attacks. Duration: 2 rounds.
signature.notes: L1 dealer[0], buff magic_twilight_effect (shoot disabler only; L3+ effect_1 adds -15% melee). Spell duration 1 + SP/6 (durationPerStack [6,1]) flattened to 2. Forest Haze (qilin_upg_alt:abilities:2) is the same effect as a 1-Focus unit active if a cheaper version is wanted.

signature.reason: Runtime-only. cove.gunpowder-defense-debuff is applied by plugin code (Homm3TrainingDamageLawRuntime.TryApplyCoveBurningAshMark): it keeps a battle-local BurningAshByTarget point counter, requires a Gunpowder-family caster and an active Cove law context, and only shows homm3_law_marker_burning_ash as a stat-less marker buff (no stats, no actions). There is no data row to graft.
signature.notes: If a data stand-in is wanted, the match csv suggests the vanilla stacking per-hit -Defense passive (A Thousand Cuts) as a separate graft; not specced here.

signature.descriptionText:
Attacks cause the target to always deal minimal Damage.
Duration: 2 round(s).
signature.notes: Implemented entirely on wasp_upg's attacks: damageDealer.buff {sid wasp_debuff, duration 2}, buffTarget_ enemy; wasp_debuff sets stats.alwaysMinDmg=true (addition duration). No logic passive row exists for it. Wasp's counterattack carries the same buff; apply it to fused counterattacks too if the builder supports that.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus without ending the turn to make target friendly creature deal +20% Damage with Ranged and Long Reach attacks. Duration: 2 rounds.
signature.notes: L1 dealer[0], buff magic_favorable_wind_effect_0 (flat +20% shoot/range; L2 30%, L3-L4 40%). Spell duration 1 + SP/5 flattened to 2.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus without ending the turn to make target friendly creature take -30% Ranged Damage. Duration: 2 rounds.
signature.notes: L1 dealer[0], buff magic_optical_illusion_effect_0 (flat -30% incoming shoot; L2 -45%, L4 also Long Reach). Spell duration 1 + SP/4 flattened to 2.

attackType_ 'shoot', 3 targets, statDmgMult 0.5 (50% basic = 2-7 per creature on targets, half that to adjacent enemies). Scales per creature. CAVEAT: the fused unit has no ranged attack (water and air elementals are melee), so the builder must confirm a 'shoot' ability works on a melee unit. If not, add shootRange or set attackType_ 'cast'.

signature.descriptionText: Makes an additional attack, dealing 50% of a basic attack (2–7 per creature) as Pure Damage to the target enemy and all adjacent enemies. Affected enemies take +50% Magic Damage for 2 rounds.
signature.notes: statDmgMult 0.5, absolute damage, attack_rumble_x1_x100. Also applies frostworm_rider_debuff (Piercing Cold: +50% magic damage taken, 2 rounds), which the vanilla card leaves out, so custom text is used. Free action (actionCost 0). Per creature, no patch.

signature.descriptionText: Upon death, this creature burns in a fire vortex, dealing 16-17 Magic Damage per creature in the stack to all adjacent creatures (friend and foe).
signature.notes: Verbatim phoenix_upg unit_died action (magic_pure, minStackDmg=maxStackDmg=55, statDmgMult 0, pattern attack_rumble_x1_x100, tag phoenix_died_damage). BALANCE FLAG: 55/creature is tuned for a T7 (phoenix avg 55); fused avg is 9, so this is ~6x avg per creature. The rule keeps vanilla per-creature numbers, but if the builder can patch the grafted action's damageDealer, recommend minStackDmg 16 / maxStackDmg 17 (k=1.8 area) and update the text to match. Lead: vanilla 55 per creature (tier-7 Phoenix) scaled to the area rule 1.8 x avg 9.0.

Teleports anywhere within movement range, then deals statDmgMult 1.0 (100% basic, 7-18 per creature on the fused unit) as Magic Damage to all adjacent creatures. damageTarget all, so allies are hit too. Already scales per creature, so no patch.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to place 2 invisible traps on free hexes for 3 rounds. A ground creature that moves through a trap is halted, its turn ends and its next turn is skipped; the trap then disappears. A trap on the last hex of a route does not trigger, unless a creature flies, jumps or teleports onto it or is forcefully moved there.
signature.notes: L1 dealer[0] (numTargets 2). spawn_object trap tuple is [kind,sid,baseRounds,divisor,perPower]: the spell's 1/7/1 gives lifetime 1 + power/7, and from a unit 'power' is the caster stack size (h3_goblin_upg_alt clones it as-is plus a 6th 'true'), so patched to a flat 3 rounds (3/1/0, same form as the Firewall unit trap 2/1/0 on h3_earth_elemental_upg_alt). Trap row magic_space_trap_snare_summon and its skip-turn buff (duration 2) are not SP-scaled.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to deal 19-20 Magic Damage per creature in this stack to each of up to 3 different target enemies.
signature.notes: L1 dealer[0] (numTargets 3; L3+ is 4). Multi-target k=1.5 x 12.5; spell base 50 + 5/SP replaced.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to give target friendly creature Double Strike (it attacks twice); it also deals and takes +10% Damage. Duration: 2 rounds.
signature.notes: L1 dealer[0], buff magic_hksmillas_rampage_effect_0 (sequenceEffect add_attack_after_counter, flat +10% out/in; L4 +40%). Spell duration 1 + SP/8 flattened to 2. Ends the turn so a self-cast cannot double-strike in the same activation.
side_buff side_buff_unit_twinkle: own hero +2 Spell Power for 1 round. No damage. Row has disableForAi: true. The donor's rank 1 / 1-energy envelope is kept even though the fused unit is high tier.

3 chosen hexes (attack_rumble_x1_x100), minStackDmg/maxStackDmg 6, magic_pure, damageTarget all (hits allies too). This is already per creature and has no flat base, so the vanilla 6 per creature is kept by the rule. That is weak for a fused unit with avg 22.5 (k about 0.27). If the lead wants it re-tuned: dealerPatch {minStackDmg 34, maxStackDmg 35} (k=1.5) plus descriptionText.
Targets a hex or enemy (attack_rumble_x2_star_x100) and pulls stacks toward it (push_unit true). No damage. Donor actionCost 0 kept (free action).

signature.descriptionText:
Deals 14–15 Pure Damage per creature in this stack to all enemies and gives them -1 Speed and Initiative.
Duration: 2 round(s).
signature.notes: The donor deals a flat 25 (minBaseDmg/maxBaseDmg 25), so it is patched to per-creature damage. I used k=1.5 (multi-target) because it hits every enemy on the battlefield: round(1.5*9)=14, max 15. The area value k=1.8 would give 16/17. The arbitrator_debuff (-1 Speed/Initiative, 2 rounds) is kept.
Two global_dispel mechanics (ally negative, enemy positive), instacast, no damage. Row has disableForAi: true.
berserk mechanic on one enemy. Does not work on embodiments or constructs. No damage. Row has disableForAi: true.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to deal 41-42 Magic Damage per creature in this stack to all creatures, allies included, on the target hex and up to 2 hexes away. The furthest affected creatures are pulled toward the center if possible.
signature.notes: L1 dealer[0] (attack_rumble_x2_star_x100, damageTarget all = friendly fire, push_unit pull kept). Area k=1.8 x 22.5 = 40.5 rounded half-up to 41 (Python round() gives 40); spell base 80 + 15/SP replaced.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus without ending the turn, once per battle, to summon 1 Starchild per 2 Nebulas on an adjacent free hex. They disappear at the end of the battle.
signature.notes: L1/L2 use summon_with_buff with an explicit 'spellPower' count source plus a Silence buff, so they cannot work from a unit; used L3 dealer[2] spawn_object instead, patched to the Tidecaller-tested tuple 0/2/1 (1 per 2 casters; the spell's 8/1/1 would be 8 + power) and the graverobber/sea-witch cast targeting (spell targets hexes near allies within 2). Deviation: summoned Starchildren are NOT silenced (they can use Starfall if they build Focus). Envelope follows Summon Fangarms (h3_sea_witch_upg_alt: cd 99, charges 1, actionCost 0); if the builder ignores 'charges', cd 99 still limits it to once.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus without ending the turn to deal 21-22 Magic Damage per creature in this stack to target enemy creature and reduce its Initiative by 3. Duration: 2 rounds.
signature.notes: L1 dealer[0] (buff magic_ice_bolt_effect_0: flat -3 Initiative, no SP scaling; L4 uses effect_1 at -6). Damage 2.3 x 9.0 single target; spell base 50 + 10/SP replaced.

signature.descriptionText: Blinks to any free hex within 4 hexes.
signature.notes: Uses the custom Silver Pegasus copy of aqualotl_upg:abilities:1 (teleport, shootRange 4) because its envelope (1 energy, cd 1) is sane. The vanilla aqualotl row is dontUseEnergy, cd 0, energy 0, actionCost 0, an unlimited free blink that depends on its Awaken kit. No damage.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus without ending the turn to reduce target enemy creature's Speed by 2. Duration: 2 rounds.
signature.notes: L1 dealer[0], buff magic_web_effect_0 (flat -2 Speed; L2 -3, L3+ also dispels Haste). Spell duration 2 + SP/5 flattened to 2.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to erupt at a target hex: every creature within 1 hex of it (allies included) takes 23-24 Magic Damage per creature in this stack and is pushed away from the centre.
signature.notes: L1 dealer (L3+ adds a -2 Initiative buff; skipped). Area k=1.8 x avg 12.5 = 22.5 -> 23 (half-up). statDmgMult 0 is required: unit casts default statDmgMult=1 and would add the unit's damageMin per creature (h3_jotunn_upg_alt's Avalanche has this). Dealer keeps the primal_13_magic_avalanche_damage tag, so Water-line elementals (Living Water) are immune, allied or enemy.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to place 2 vents on free hexes for 2 rounds. When a ground creature steps on one, it erupts once, dealing 21-22 Magic Damage per creature in this stack to that creature and every creature adjacent to it (allies included).
signature.notes: The vanilla trap does (100% + 5% x caster SP) of the target's single-creature max HP, and a trap's SP is the casting unit's creature count. A per-creature rule needs a new trap row, so helper h3_fusion_vent_trap clones magic_space_trap_jaws_summon_1 with flat 21/22 per creature (trap k=1.5 x 14). Lifetime is set to a flat 2 using the Firewall (h3_earth_elemental_upg_alt) tuple 2/1/0; vanilla is 1 + 1 per 5 SP. The vanilla trap row has no hiddenFromEnemy, so the traps are probably visible to the enemy and the text does not say they are hidden.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus without ending the turn to restore 52 HP per creature in this stack to an allied living stack. Cannot revive fallen creatures.
signature.notes: MechHealing for a unit caster heals healFlat + allStacks x (values[2]/values[1]), so the vanilla 50 + 5 per SP becomes 0 + 52 per creature, mirroring single-target damage (2.3 x 22.5 = 51.75 -> 52). No revive, so it cannot outpace a 52-per-creature hit. The unit's heal-% bonuses still apply. L1 is used because L3+ adds an SP-scaled regen buff. Tags make undead, constructs, embodiments and avatars untargetable.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to turn the tide: all friendly creatures gain +1 Speed and +1 Initiative and all enemy creatures lose 1 Speed and 1 Initiative for 2 rounds.
signature.notes: global_buff values = (allegiance, buff, hardDuration, durationPerStack, stacksPer, charges); vanilla gives 2 + SP/8 rounds, so durationPerStack is zeroed for a flat 2. Level 2 = dealer[1]; L4 also dispels movement buffs and debuffs, which is skipped.
Single-enemy debuff aqualotl_debuff_1: -2 Speed and -2 Initiative for 3 rounds. The buff row carries only stats; the 'Confused' wording comes from the vanilla card. No damage.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 1 Focus to corrode an enemy, permanently reducing its Defense by 1. Repeated casts stack.
signature.notes: Single-enemy cast of buff pet_debuff (Bone Crusher row: defence -1, infinite, addition data so each cast adds another -1, cannot be dispelled, kept on death), energy 1, cd 1. pet_debuff is hidden, so the target shows no status icon.

signature.descriptionText: Applies a copy of all positive effects currently on this creature to a friendly creature.
signature.notes: transfer_buffs [copy, 0, positive] onto an allynoself target. Custom text drops the vanilla Haven-specific 'Forging Perfection' clause. Row has disableForAi: true.

Teleports to any hex (shootRange 99), then deals 100% basic (6-12 per creature) normal damage to all adjacent creatures, allies included (damageTarget all), and pushes them away. Per creature, no patch.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus to shred an enemy's Attack and Defense by 2 for 2 rounds.
signature.notes: Single-enemy cast of buff magic_shorten_shadow_effect_0 (Shorten Shadow level-1 effect: defence -2, offence -2, flat, no spell-power scaling), duration 2, energy 2, cd 3. Non-damaging, no dealerPatch.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to summon a mirror copy of an allied stack on an adjacent hex for 2 rounds. The copy deals -67% and takes +200% Damage and can't use special abilities.
signature.notes: The ordered copy_unit path copies the first target, not the caster, with its full creature count. Vanilla duration is 1 + SP/7, which becomes per 7 creatures for a unit, so durationPerSp is zeroed and the duration is a flat 2. L2 debuff magic_mirror_copy_debuff_1 is used (L1 is -75%/+300%).

signature.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus without ending the turn to raise 2 crystal obstacles on free hexes for 3 rounds. Each crystal is destroyed by 1 hit.
signature.notes: spawn_object ['obstacle','crystal_crown_1','1'] has no per-stat tuple, so the amount does not scale with creature count. Obstacle crystal_crown_1 has lifetime 3, hp 1 and maxInDmg 1. L3 places 3 crystals; L4 places 3 that take 2 hits.
side_buff side_buff_unit_aqualotl: enemy hero -2 Attack/Defense/Spell Power/Knowledge for 1 round, untargeted instacast. No damage. Donor rank 1 envelope kept.

signature.descriptionText: Enemy creatures adjacent to this creature take +30% Magic Damage. This effect does not stack.
signature.notes: No passive row: the effect is qilin_upg's top-level logic.aura (radius 1, enemy, inDmgMods magic_damage +0.3), copied verbatim via logicFields. Neither parent (h3_water_elemental_upg_alt, h3_fire_elemental_upg) has an aura, so nothing is overwritten. The shared tag qilin_aura keeps it non-stacking with real qilins.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to deal 23-24 Magic Damage per creature in this stack to target enemy creature. All adjacent empty hexes are filled with rock obstacles that last 2 rounds; each obstacle is destroyed by 1 hit.
signature.notes: L3 dealer[2] chosen for obstacle cave_in_obstacle_1 (lifetime 2, hp 1, maxInDmg 1; the L1-L2 obstacle lasts 1 round). summon_in_pattern tuple 1/1/0 has no power scaling. Single-target k=2.3 x 10.0; spell base 150 + 15/SP replaced.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus without ending the turn to shorten every negative effect on an allied stack by 2 rounds; effects reduced to 0 are removed. Cannot target undead or constructs.
signature.notes: MechAddBuffDuration values = (type, duration, durationPerStack, stacksPer, tags); amount = -2 + durationPerStack*SP/5, and a unit caster's SP is its creature count, so durationPerStack is zeroed for a flat -2.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus without ending the turn to teleport an allied stack (itself included) to a free hex up to 4 hexes from its current hex.
signature.notes: The L1 dealer has no SP scaling. Ordered unit-cast teleport matches vanilla arbitrator Command: Reposition, which is the same dealer except it uses allynoself. L1's 4 hexes matches the unit precedents (arbitrator, Clan Warp); L2 would give 6.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus without ending the turn to calm an enemy stack: it deals -20% Damage with basic attacks for 2 rounds.
signature.notes: L2 = buff magic_unnatural_calm_effect_1 (normal_damage -0.2). The vanilla duration 1 + SP/4 is replaced by a flat 2. L3+ are instacast simultaneous variants and are skipped.
side_buff side_buff_disable_magic_book: the enemy hero's spellbook is disabled for 1 round. No damage. Row has disableForAi: true.
dispel negative + dispel positive on any other unit (castTarget noself). No damage. Row has disableForAi: true. h3_faerie_dragon:abilities:0 is the same row.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 1 Focus to grant an allied stack +2 Morale for 6 rounds. Limited to 2 casts per battle.
signature.notes: Ally-target cast of buff homm3_cove_mirth_effect (stats.moral +2, addition duration), duration 6, charges 2, energy 1, cd 1. Flat values, no spell-power scaling.

signature.descriptionText: Steals 2 mana from the enemy hero (if present) at the start of its turn.
signature.notes: fairy_dragon passives[0] bundles the start_turn change_mana ['transfer','ally','2','0','0','false'] action with data.immunities (magic_level 5 + dragon_immunities). Those immunities exactly duplicate guest h3_psychic_elemental_upg passives[0], so the verbatim graft adds no new immunity; dedupe if wanted.

statDmgMult 1.5 (150% basic, about 10-20 per creature on the fused unit) as Magic Damage to one enemy (it can also target defense structures), plus gorilla_stun (skip_turn) for 1 round. Per creature, no patch. The card keeps its vanilla name 'Big Rock, Rrr!'; set nameText if the lead wants it renamed.

Self buff black_dragon_buff for 2 rounds: revenge_damage [flat, magic_pure, 0, 30, 1, 10, melee] on melee hits. Base 0 and 30 is most likely per creature (the matching Vengeance-style day-magic rows use 60 base + 15/20 per SP), so it is kept. The damage sits inside the buff, so a dealerPatch cannot reach it. At 30 per creature on avg 22.5 it is strong (k about 1.3 per melee hit); re-tuning needs a helper copy of the buff.

signature.descriptionText:
Deals 41-42 Magic Damage per creature in this stack to all enemies within two hexes of this creature and sets them on fire. Burning creatures take 14–15 Magic Damage per creature in the casting stack at the start of their turn. This effect is stackable.
Duration: 2 round(s).
signature.notes: The direct hit (minStackDmg/maxStackDmg 60, no base) is already per creature, so it is kept by the rule. It is very strong at avg 22.5 (k about 2.7); the rule value would be 40/41 (k=1.8). The burn buff phoenix_ignition has a flat 60 base + 30/creature, so it is replaced by a helper copy patched to the DoT rule: round(0.6*22.5)=14, max 15, base 0. The helper path/file name is a suggestion. Verify that buff stack damage counts the caster's creatures. Lead: direct hit 60 per creature scaled to the area rule 1.8 x avg 22.5; helper buff lives beside phoenix_ignition.
Self buff ent_buff for 2 rounds: Attack is added to Defense and Attack is set to 0. Free action (actionCost 0), no damage. Donor envelope kept.

signature.descriptionText: Leaves a stone obstacle after death. It is destroyed after taking Damage 2 times.
signature.notes: Verbatim ent_upg unit_died spawn_object 'ent_stone' on its own hex; obstacle ent_stone (DB/field_objects/obstacles/obstacles_units.json) has hp 2, maxInDmg 1 and is immune to kill_stacks, so it breaks after 2 hits.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus without ending the turn to ignore attackers' Attack values until the end of the round.
signature.notes: Self-cast buff h3_runic_guard_effect (clone of native minos_buff: stats.attackPen 1.0, duration 1, maxDuration 1); donor row has actionCost 0 (free), energy 2, cd 2, rank 3. Envelope just restates the donor values.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus without ending the turn to encase an allied stack in a crystal shell for 2 rounds: the next instance of Damage it takes is negated.
signature.notes: dealersPerLevels is [0,0,1,2], so level 3 = dealer[1]: duration 2, 1 charge. The buff's durationPerStack [5,1] (+1 per 5 SP, i.e. per 5 creatures for a unit) is removed by the flat buffDuration 2.

signature.descriptionText:
Attacks poison the target. Poisoned creatures take 24 Magic Damage plus 6 per creature in the attacking stack at the start of their turn. This effect is stackable.
Duration: 2 round(s).
signature.notes: Implemented on giant_frog's attacks: buff {sid frog_poison, duration 2}, buffTarget_ enemy. frog_poison (addition none, so applications stack) deals magic_pure minBaseDmg 24 + minStackDmg 6 per creature at start_turn, tagged overTime_effect_poison (poison-immune units ignore it). Vanilla per-creature numbers kept (6/creature, under the 0.6*26=16 rule value). The guest's Sweeping Strike spreads the poison to all swept targets.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus without ending the turn to curse an enemy stack for 2 rounds: at the start of each of its turns it takes 15 Pure Damage plus 15 per creature in this stack. Repeated curses stack. Undead, constructs and magic creatures are immune.
signature.notes: The damage lives in buff magic_despair_effect_1 (15 base + 15 x SP). BuffActionHandler takes SP from the buff's caster, and a unit's SP is its creature count, so the DoT already scales per creature from data. The rule asks for 14 per tick (0.6 x 23); vanilla 15 + 15 flat is kept to avoid a new buff row. L3 is single-target; L4 is an area cast.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to brand an enemy stack for 2 rounds: each time it moves, waits, skips its turn or uses an ability, it takes 17-18 Magic Damage per creature in this stack.
signature.notes: The vanilla mark buffs carry a hero-sized flat base (150 or 200) plus 15 or 20 x SP, and SP becomes the caster's creature count for a unit, so the flat base would dominate. Helper buff h3_fusion_sigil_mark clones magic_nairas_kiss_effect_0 with base 0 and 17/18 per creature (DoT k=0.6 x 27.5 = 16.5 -> 17). Its triggers are unit_wait, unit_skip, unit_end_move and unit_cast_ability; a stationary attack does not trigger it. The cloned description_ token may still render vanilla numbers, so the builder should set the buff text.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus to release an energy pulse at a target hex: every creature within 1 hex of it (allies included) takes 50-51 Magic Damage per creature in this stack.
signature.notes: In a unit cast, damagePerEnergyLevel adds a flat 30 x the army's current Focus level (energyManager.GetCurrentLevelID) and does not scale with creature count, so it is dropped. The unit version does fixed per-creature area damage (k=1.8 x 27.5 = 49.5 -> 50) for a 2-Focus cost and does not grow with stored Focus. statDmgMult 0 is set for the same reason as Geyser.
Single enemy gets unspeakable_debuff for 1 round (skip_turn, actionPoints -99). Not dispellable. Does not work on embodiments or constructs. Row has disableForAi: true, so the AI never casts it.

signature.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus without ending the turn to make target friendly creature untargetable. The effect ends when that creature takes damage, moves, waits, defends or uses an ability, or at the end of the round.
signature.notes: L1 dealer[0], buff magic_shade_cloak_effect_0 (untargetable only, maxDuration 1, flat). L2-L4 add +25%/+50% damage dealt; skipped. Self-cast is near-useless (the cloak drops on the caster's next action); meant for allies. Veil of Shadows (assassin_upg_alt:abilities:0) is the self-only unit twin.

h3_fusion_ii_dirty_thunder.name: Dirty Thunder Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_dirty_thunder.narrative: Dirty Thunder Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Ash Elemental and Lightning Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to hurl ash-laden lightning at target enemy creature, dealing 35-36 Magic Damage per creature in this stack. The bolt then jumps to up to 3 more enemies within 3 hexes, each jump dealing 50% less Damage than the last. Every struck enemy loses 2 Initiative for 1 round.
signatures.notes: Chain Lightning L3 dealer[2] (numTargets 4 = target + 3 jumps, -50% per jump kept). Cast/affect/ordered params narrowed from 'all' to 'enemy' so allies are never chained. Chain k=1.5 x 23.0 = 34.5 -> 35 (half-up); spell base 300 + 20/SP replaced. Ash rider = magic_avalanche_effect_0 (flat -2 Initiative, vanilla Circle of Winter L3 debuff), duration 1.

h3_fusion_ii_pyrocumulus.name: Pyrocumulus Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_pyrocumulus.narrative: Pyrocumulus Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Wildfire Elemental and Thunderhead Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to rain fire on a target hex: every creature within 1 hex of it (allies included) takes 30-31 Magic Damage per creature in this stack and is set on fire for 2 rounds. Burning creatures take 10-11 Magic Damage per creature in this stack at the start of their turn.
signatures.notes: Fireball L1 dealer (attack_rumble_x1_x100, damageTarget all = vanilla friendly fire kept; the burn follows the same targets via buffTarget_ all). Area k=1.8 x 16.5 = 29.7 -> 30; spell base 50 + 10/SP replaced. Burn = helper clone of phoenix_ignition (flat 60 + 30/creature) at the DoT rule 0.6 x 16.5 = 9.9 -> 10/11, base 0, addition 'duration' (refreshes instead of stacking). Verify the buff's stack damage counts the caster's creatures (same open question as stage-1 Supernova).

h3_fusion_ii_supercell.name: Supercell Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_supercell.narrative: Supercell Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Hail Elemental and Thunderhead Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to call down hail on a target hex: every enemy within 2 hexes of it takes 29-30 Magic Damage per creature in this stack and loses 1 Speed for 1 round. Allies are not harmed.
signatures.notes: Contaminating Blast (hive_queen) is the vanilla radius-2 target-hex unit cast (attack_rumble_x2_x100, full radius 2). Its 50% basic-attack damage (statDmgMult 0.5) is replaced by the area rule 1.8 x 16.0 = 28.8 -> 29/30, and affect/damage targets are narrowed to enemies. -1 Speed rider = minos_debuff (vanilla Balthazar's Tramp, flat -1 Speed).

h3_fusion_ii_maelstrom.name: Maelstrom Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_maelstrom.narrative: Maelstrom Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Current Elemental and Typhoon Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to open a whirlpool on a target hex: every creature on it and up to 2 hexes away (allies included) takes 35-36 Magic Damage per creature in this stack and loses 2 Speed for 1 round. The furthest affected creatures are pulled toward the centre if possible.
signatures.notes: Black Hole L1 dealer (attack_rumble_x2_star_x100, push_unit pull kept, damageTarget all). Vanilla pulls only the furthest ring, not every creature as the concept says; kept as-is rather than inventing a mechanic. Area k=1.8 x 19.5 = 35.1 -> 35; base 80 + 15/SP replaced. Rider magic_web_effect_0 (flat -2 Speed) for 1 round on everything struck.

h3_fusion_ii_polar_vortex.name: Polar Vortex Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_polar_vortex.narrative: Polar Vortex Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Blizzard Elemental and Polar Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Enemy creatures within 2 hexes of this creature have -2 Initiative and -1 Speed. This effect does not stack.
signatures.notes: Data aura in the same shape as qilin_upg / black_dragon_upg_alt logic.aura (enemy target, data.stats), values from the concept. Every vanilla aura uses radius 1; radius 2 is the first use of that value, so check in battle that it reaches 2 hexes (fallback: radius 1 and text 'adjacent'). Card donor Dominating Presence (enemy-aura icon), text overridden. Host h3_fusion_ice_astral has no aura, nothing is overwritten.

h3_fusion_ii_dust_devil.name: Dust Devil Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_dust_devil.narrative: Dust Devil Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Dust Elemental and Vortex Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus to whip up a dust cloud on a target hex: every enemy on it or within 1 hex of it takes 52-53 Magic Damage per creature in this stack, can't counterattack and deals -30% Ranged Damage for 1 round.
signatures.notes: Same donor as Supercell (hive_queen Contaminating Blast) with the pattern narrowed to attack_rumble_x1_x100. Helper buff = magic_shackles_effect (vanilla no-counterattack disabler) plus outDmgMods shoot_attack -0.3; its tooltip reuses the Shackles tokens, so the buff tooltip shows only the counterattack part. Area rule 1.8 x 29.0 = 52.2 -> 52/53; the concept says 'small' damage, so the lead may want a lower k here (e.g. 1.0 -> 29/30).

h3_fusion_ii_haboob.name: Haboob Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_haboob.narrative: Haboob Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Dune Elemental and Sirocco Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to raise a sandstorm on a target hex: every enemy on it or within 2 hexes of it can't make Ranged attacks for 1 round.
signatures.notes: Twilight L1 dealer (buff magic_twilight_effect, shoot disabler only) turned into an area cast: hexOrObject target, attack_rumble_x2_x100, enemies affected. Duration 1 + SP/6 flattened to 1. No damage, as in the concept.

h3_fusion_ii_rainbow.name: Rainbow Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_rainbow.narrative: Rainbow Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Prism Elemental and Rain Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to arc a rainbow over a target hex: every friendly creature on it or within 2 hexes of it is cleansed of all negative effects and restores 35 HP per creature in this stack. Cannot revive fallen creatures or affect undead, constructs or embodiments.
signatures.notes: Holy Ablution (lightweaver_upg: dispel negative + full heal on all allies, instacast) re-shaped into a radius-2 target-hex cast (hive_queen pattern and params). The full heal_percent is replaced by the Healing Water heal mech as in stage-1 Wellspring (0 + 35 per creature, no respawn); area rule 1.8 x 19.5 = 35.1 -> 35. The donor's undead/embodiment/construct/avatar immunity tags are kept.

h3_fusion_ii_borealis.name: Borealis Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_borealis.narrative: Borealis Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Aurora Elemental and Polar Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Adjacent friendly stacks gain +1 Morale and +1 Luck. This effect does not stack.
signatures.notes: Aura shaped like h3_leprechaun's Lucky Charm (radius 1, allynoself, stats luck 1) with moral 1 added; own tag, so it stacks with Lucky Charm but not with another Borealis. Card donor Lucky Charm, text overridden.

h3_fusion_ii_lahar.name: Lahar Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_lahar.narrative: Lahar Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Mud Elemental and Volcano Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus to attack in Melee with a surge of volcanic mud that strikes the target and the 2 hexes behind it, dealing 30-31 Magic Damage per creature in this stack to each enemy hit and reducing their Speed by 2 for 2 rounds. Does not provoke a counterattack.
signatures.notes: No vanilla ranged line cast exists, so the line is a melee special: the Reap Without Sowing (avatar_of_war_upg_alt) row with its swipe pattern swapped for attack_reach_x2_x100_x100_x100 (the 3-hex line h3_naga_upg_alt uses), kill_stacks removed, damage switched to per-creature magic. Line k=1.5 x 20.0 = 30/31. Rider magic_web_effect_0 (flat -2 Speed) for 2 rounds. Host h3_fusion_magma_fire is melee, so the line follows the attack facing.

h3_fusion_ii_supervolcano.name: Supervolcano Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_supervolcano.narrative: Supervolcano Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Mantle Elemental and Caldera Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Once per battle, spend 3 Focus to erupt: every other creature within 2 hexes of this creature, allies included, takes 50-51 Magic Damage per creature in this stack.
signatures.notes: Supernova (phoenix_upg_alt) is the vanilla self-centred radius-2 fire burst (attack_swirl_x2_x100, affect noself); damageTarget widened from enemy to all for friendly fire, the burn buff dropped, charges 1. Centred on the caster instead of a target hex (the volcano erupts where it stands). Area rule 1.8 x 27.5 = 49.5 -> 50/51; the concept asks for a 'large' value, so the lead may raise it to the single-target k=2.3 (63/64) given once-per-battle and friendly fire.

h3_fusion_ii_fulgurite.name: Fulgurite Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_fulgurite.narrative: Fulgurite Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Sand Elemental and Lightning Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Whenever an enemy attacks this creature in Melee, the attacker takes 12 Magic Damage per creature in this stack. Takes -25% Ranged Damage.
signatures.notes: Fire Shield style: helper buff clones black_dragon_buff (Inner Flame: revenge_damage flat 0 + 30 per creature, melee) at 12 per creature (DoT-tick k=0.6 x 20.0, since it fires on every melee hit), made infinite and undispellable, and applied at battle start by an aqualotl-style start_battle self passive set through logicFields.passives (which replaces the emptied passive list). A flat per-creature value stands in for the concept's '25% reflected' because revenge_damage has no damage-percent mode. Ranged defense via stats.inDmgMods shoot_attack -0.25 (esquire format). The buff tooltip reuses Inner Flame's name/description tokens.

h3_fusion_ii_glass.name: Glass Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_glass.narrative: Glass Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Sand Elemental and Furnace Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Takes -25% Magic Damage.
signatures.notes: The -25% magic part is data (stats.inDmgMods magic_damage -0.25, h3_crystal_dragon / h3_golem format). The 30% reflect needs builderNeeds; until it exists use descriptionTextDataOnly. Card donor Crystal Scales, text overridden. Unbuilt part (needs runtime): A runtime hook giving this unit a 30% chance to reflect a hostile single-target spell or ability back at its caster; Core has no data mechanic for spell reflection (no reflect mech, stat or immunity type).

h3_fusion_ii_quicksilver.name: Quicksilver Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_quicksilver.narrative: Quicksilver Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Cinnabar Elemental and Crucible Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: +3 Initiative. After a Melee attack, this creature returns to the hex it started from.
signatures.notes: +3 Initiative as a permanent logic passive {data.stats} (same form as h3_nix attackPen and godslayer_upg_alt maxAddedApPerRound), set via logicFields.passives; if passive data.stats turns out not to add Initiative, swap for a start_battle infinite self-buff with stats.initiative 3 (Fulgurite pattern). Strike-and-return is a flag on attack rows (returnToStartAfterAttack) that passive_graft cannot set on default attacks, hence builderNeeds. Host h3_fusion_magma_magic attacks in melee; its frog_poison rider is stripped by the passive-signature kit rule.

h3_fusion_ii_philosophers_stone.name: Philosopher's Stone Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_philosophers_stone.narrative: Philosopher's Stone Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Crucible Elemental and Starforge Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to turn an adjacent enemy stack to stone for 1 round: it skips its turn, can't counterattack, and takes -50% Damage while petrified.
signatures.notes: Stone Gaze (h3_medusa: melee-range buff cast, medusa_stone for 1 round) cloned; its buff is swapped for a helper copy of medusa_stone whose +100% normal damage taken and magic immunity become -50% normal and -50% magic damage taken (the concept's 'takes -50% damage'). Buff tooltip uses the Petrification name and the Spatial Snare skip-turn text, since no existing token says -50%.

h3_fusion_ii_causeway.name: Causeway Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_causeway.narrative: Causeway Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Basalt Elemental and Tide Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus without ending the turn to raise 3 basalt pillars on free hexes for 3 rounds. Each pillar is destroyed after 2 hits.
signatures.notes: Crystal Crown L4 dealer (numTargets 3, simultaneous hex picks). Its crystal_crown_2 obstacle (lifetime 3, hp 2, maxInDmg 1) is cloned as helper h3_fusion_ii_basalt_pillar with the ent_stone (Stoneheart) rock visual and sounds, so the pillars read as basalt, not crystal. The spawn_object tuple has no power term, so nothing scales with SP.

h3_fusion_ii_henge.name: Henge Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_henge.narrative: Henge Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Runestone Elemental and Monolith Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Adjacent friendly stacks take -25% Magic Damage. This effect does not stack. This creature is immune to mind spells: Sleep, Silence and Berserk.
signatures.notes: Aura = inquisitor_upg Malleus Maleficarum (ally, inDmgMods magic_damage -0.3) at -0.25 with the esquire_upg_alt 'allynoself' target so only neighbours benefit; own tag. Mind immunity = h3_giant passives[0] verbatim (sleep_effect, silenceEffect, homm3_mind_berserk_effect, berserk mechanic). One card carries both parts because passive_graft writes the same text on every card.

h3_fusion_ii_permafrost.name: Permafrost Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_permafrost.narrative: Permafrost Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Tundra Elemental and Polar Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus to freeze the ground at a target hex: every enemy on it or adjacent to it is rooted for 1 round (its Speed is set to 0; it can still attack and use abilities).
signatures.notes: Circle of Winter L1 kept for its frost hex VFX; pattern widened from attack_circle (ring) to attack_rumble_x1_x100 (centre + ring); damage, push and the avalanche immunity tag removed. Root = ent_root (vanilla ent root: statOverrides speed 0), the same buff h3_dendroid_guard's Binding uses. ent_root's own tooltip name renders as 'Crystal Thorns' in vanilla.

h3_fusion_ii_iceberg.name: Iceberg Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_iceberg.narrative: Iceberg Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Glacier Elemental and Tide Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Takes -40% Ranged Damage and -40% Magic Damage.
signatures.notes: Pure stat passive: stats.inDmgMods in the animated_armor format (shoot_attack / magic_damage entries). The passive-signature kit rule empties the host's damage mods first, so these are the only ones. Card donor Ranged Defense III, text overridden.

h3_fusion_ii_hoarfrost.name: Hoarfrost Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_hoarfrost.narrative: Hoarfrost Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Rime Elemental and Mist Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Ranged attacks, melee attacks and counterattacks chill the target for 2 rounds: each time it would act, it has a 25% chance to lose its turn. Repeated hits refresh the duration; they do not stack.
signatures.notes: No random proc-on-hit mechanic exists in Core, so the freeze is the vanilla skip-chance stat: helper buff h3_fusion_ii_hoarfrost_chill clones homm3_cove_fearsome_effect (skipActionChanceModifier 0.1) at 0.25, the same stat avatar_of_war_upg_alt's aura uses. Duration 2 so a target that already acted still gets a roll on its next turn. The stage-2 builder strips attack buffs, so the rider is set by logicFields copies of host Rime's three attack lists (current overlay rows, Frostbite swapped for the chill); refresh them if Rime's attacks change. The buff borrows Fearsome's name/description tokens (that text says 10%); own buff text 'Hoarfrost: 25% chance to skip its turn.' would be better.

h3_fusion_ii_jokulhlaup.name: Jokulhlaup Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_jokulhlaup.narrative: Jokulhlaup Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Volcano Elemental and Glacier Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to strike an adjacent enemy with a flood of meltwater that runs through 3 hexes in a line (the target and the 2 hexes behind it). Each enemy struck takes 150% of this creature's basic attack (about 21-38 per creature in this stack) as Magic Damage and is pushed away from this creature if possible.
signatures.notes: Minotaur Onslaught (melee ability attack + push_unit_from_caster) with the 3-hex line pattern attack_reach_x2_x100_x100_x100_with_delay. Damage is magic_pure at statDmgMult 1.5, as with h3_pikeman_upg Halberd Hook (magic_pure statDmgMult 1.0): 1.5 x avg 19.5 = 29.25 per creature, the multi-target k=1.5, while staying on the melee-ability damage path. The concept said push 2 hexes, but push_unit_from_caster has no distance value, so it pushes the engine's 1 hex. Check the line pattern and the push on every affected target once in game.

h3_fusion_ii_spring.name: Spring Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_spring.narrative: Spring Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Thaw Elemental and Dawn Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: At the start of each of its turns, restores 19 HP per creature in this stack to every allied stack within 2 hexes, itself included. Cannot revive fallen creatures.
signatures.notes: h3_wight Regeneration row (start_turn, allegiance self), re-targeted to a self-centred attack_swirl_x2_x100 (the pattern of phoenix_upg_alt Supernova) that affects allies, with the heal mech in Healing Water form (0 + 19 per creature). 19 = per-tick rule 0.6 x avg 31.5, since it fires free every turn. Check whether the swirl includes the caster's own hex; if not, drop 'itself included' from the text.

h3_fusion_ii_fountain_of_youth.name: Fountain of Youth Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_fountain_of_youth.narrative: Fountain of Youth Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Wellspring Elemental and Dawn Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to restore 93 HP per creature in this stack to an allied stack. This can revive fallen creatures, up to the stack's starting number.
signatures.notes: Rewind Life L1 dealer[0] (revive mech; vanilla 50 + 20 per SP) set to 0 + 93 per creature = 2.3 x avg 40.5, the single-target rule. Assumes the revive values use the heal layout [flat, spDivisor, perSp, mode]. Cooldown 3 per concept; it ends the turn because it revives (stage-1 Healing Water, which cannot revive, was free).

h3_fusion_ii_bolide.name: Bolide Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_bolide.narrative: Bolide Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Comet Elemental and Meteor Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to call down a meteor on a target hex at any range: the creature there takes 40-41 Magic Damage per creature in this stack, and every creature adjacent to it takes half (20-21), allies included.
signatures.notes: Fireball L1 (hexOrObject, hits all creatures) with the centre-100%/ring-50% pattern attack_rumble_x1_x100_x50 for 'heavy hit plus splash'. Centre is 2.3 x avg 17.5 = 40.25 -> 40, the single-target rule; the ring takes half. Replaces the vanilla 50 + 10/SP. Friendly fire is kept from Fireball.

h3_fusion_ii_meteor_shower.name: Meteor Shower Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_meteor_shower.narrative: Meteor Shower Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Starfall Elemental and Meteor Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to deal 44-45 Magic Damage per creature in this stack to each of up to 4 different target enemies.
signatures.notes: Stone Fangs L3 dealer (numTargets 4, enemies only). Multi-target k=1.5 x avg 29 = 43.5 -> 44 (half-up); replaces the spell's 100 + 5/SP. The visual is Stone Fangs' rock spikes, not falling stars. star_child Starfall was skipped because it is the guest's own stage-1 signature.

h3_fusion_ii_protostar.name: Protostar Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_protostar.narrative: Protostar Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Nebula Elemental and Starforge Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: At the start of each of its turns, this creature gains +1 Attack and +1 Defense until the end of battle. This effect is stackable.
signatures.notes: h3_wight start_turn self action re-pointed to apply an infinite 'addition: data' buff (stacks per application, the minos_selfbuff Blood for Blood pattern) giving +1 offence and +1 defence. Without the cap the ramp is unlimited, so the data-only text says stackable. The card is minos_upg Blood for Blood with own text. Unbuilt part (needs runtime): Cap the stacking self-buff h3_fusion_ii_accretion at 5 applications; Core buffs have no max-stack field, and 'addition: data' stacks without limit (as minos_selfbuff does).

h3_fusion_ii_singularity.name: Singularity Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_singularity.narrative: Singularity Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Supernova Elemental and Void Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to pull an enemy stack past the event horizon for 1 round: it skips its turn, cannot counterattack and cannot be targeted. When it returns it takes 94-95 Magic Damage per creature in this stack. Cannot be dispelled.
signatures.notes: Sleep L1 single-enemy cast (living-only immunity tags replaced by 'ability') carrying helper buff h3_fusion_ii_event_horizon. The buff combines Sleep's skip_turn and counter disabler, Shade Cloak's untargetable stat with no break-on-damage mechanics, and a buff_timeout damage action of 2.3 x avg 41 = 94.3 -> 94 per creature. Area effects may still hit it, because untargetable only blocks targeting. VERIFY that buff timeout damage counts the casting stack's creatures.

h3_fusion_ii_eclipse.name: Eclipse Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_eclipse.narrative: Eclipse Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Corona Elemental and Void Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to darken a target hex: every enemy within 2 hexes of it cannot counterattack and has -1 Morale and -1 Luck for 2 rounds. Also removes Riposte from them.
signatures.notes: Shackles L4 area dealer (hexOrObject, affects enemies only, dispels parryEffect), widened from radius 1 to attack_rumble_x2_x100. The helper buff clones magic_shackles_effect and adds moral -1 and luck -1. Duration is a flat 2; buffDuration strips the per-stack scaling.

h3_fusion_ii_wormhole.name: Wormhole Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_wormhole.narrative: Wormhole Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Vortex Elemental and Rift Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus without ending the turn to teleport an allied stack (itself included) to any free hex on the battlefield.
signatures.notes: Blink L1 dealer[0] (ordered ally -> hex teleport) with the hex step's distanceFromFirst raised from 4 to 99, so any hex works. Cooldown 3 instead of Blink's 2 because the range is unlimited.

h3_fusion_ii_illusionist.name: Illusionist Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_illusionist.narrative: Illusionist Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Smoke Elemental and Mirror Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Once per battle, spend 3 Focus to create a phantom copy of an allied stack on an adjacent hex for 3 rounds. The phantom deals 30% less and takes 50% more Damage and can't use special abilities.
signatures.notes: Mirror Copy L4 dealer (debuff_3: -30% damage dealt, +50% damage taken), with the copy_unit duration flattened to 3 (vanilla 1 + SP/7). charges 1 = once per battle. The extra cast tag blocks fused targets only after the builder adds the matching immunity passive. Unbuilt part (needs runtime): Give every fused unit (stage 1 and 2) a logic passive {"data": {"immunities": [{"type": "cast", "tags": ["h3_fusion_copy_immunities"]}]}} so the dealer tag blocks copying fused stacks; Core target params have no exclude-tag filter.

h3_fusion_ii_fever_dream.name: Fever Dream Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_fever_dream.narrative: Fever Dream Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Dream Elemental and Delirium Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus to make an enemy stack immediately and uncontrollably attack the closest creature within its attack radius, friend or foe. Constructs and embodiments are immune.
signatures.notes: Berserk L1 dealer[0] (berserk mech + magic_berserker_effect_0_no_damage, 1 round) with cast and affect narrowed from 'all' to 'enemy'. It is the same mechanic as stage-1 Moment of Insanity, but taken from the spell so the stage-2 kit does not reuse a parent ability row.

h3_fusion_ii_nightmare.name: Nightmare Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_nightmare.narrative: Nightmare Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Dream Elemental and Torment Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 3 Focus to terrify an enemy stack: it skips its next turn (taking Damage does not wake it) and has -3 Morale for 2 rounds. Demons, undead, embodiments and constructs are immune.
signatures.notes: Sleep L1 single-enemy cast (its living-only immunity tags kept, since this is a mind effect) carrying helper h3_fusion_ii_nightmare_terror: skip_turn + moral -3 for 1 round, with Sleep's break-on-damage mechanics removed. Its buff_timeout action applies h3_fusion_ii_nightmare_dread (moral -3, 1 round), so the Morale loss covers 2 rounds. Both buffs borrow Sleep's name and description tokens; own buff text would be nicer.

h3_fusion_ii_kaleidoscope.name: Kaleidoscope Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_kaleidoscope.narrative: Kaleidoscope Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Prism Elemental and Mirror Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Its ranged attacks split: after hitting the target, the shot jumps to up to 2 more enemies within 3 hexes, each jump dealing half the Damage of the previous hit (50%, then 25%).
signatures.notes: Host Mirror's shoot attack (current overlay row) given Chain Lightning's chain fields via logicFields: numTargets 3, multitargetType chain, ordered params narrowed to enemies, distance 3, -50% per jump. Concept wanted a flat 50% to both extra targets; per-jump halving is the closest data form. VERIFY in game: Core uses chain multitarget only on casts and abilities, never on a basic shoot attack, so runtime support is unproven. The melee alternative attack and counterattack stay single-target.

h3_fusion_ii_black_mirror.name: Black Mirror Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_black_mirror.narrative: Black Mirror Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Obsidian Elemental and Mirror Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Spend 2 Focus to scry an enemy stack: all positive effects on it are dispelled and applied to this creature.
signatures.notes: angel_upg Devouring Chalice (steal_buffs ['true'], Core's only steal mechanic) narrowed from a radius-1 area to one enemy target. It steals every positive effect; the concept's 'one effect' cannot be expressed because steal_buffs has no count. The donor row has disableForAi: true.

h3_fusion_ii_will_o_wisp.name: Will-o'-Wisp Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_will_o_wisp.narrative: Will-o'-Wisp Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Ember Elemental and Coldflame Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Enemies do not counterattack its attacks. Takes 30% less Damage from basic attacks.
signatures.notes: No-retaliation uses the vanilla Swift Strike form (godslayer_upg and h3_psychic_elemental default attacks with triggerCounter false), set by a logicFields copy of host Ember's melee attack. Dodge is adapted to inDmgMods basic_attack -0.3, which has the same average. The card is godslayer_upg Swift Strike with own text. Unbuilt part (needs runtime): A literal 30% dodge needs a runtime evasion stat (chance to negate an incoming basic attack); Core has none, so the data build uses 30% less basic-attack damage taken as the expected-value equivalent.

h3_fusion_ii_ley_line.name: Ley Line Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_ley_line.narrative: Ley Line Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Mana Elemental and Wellspring Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Adjacent allied stacks generate +1 Focus each round.
signatures.notes: Vanilla unit aura field (radius 1, allynoself, like h3_leprechaun Lucky Charm) carrying stats.energyPerRound +1. The concept said 'at the start of its turn'; the aura grants it on the round's Focus tick instead. VERIFY that aura stats add to energyPerRound at runtime; Core auras so far only use luck, morale, damage mods and skip-chance stats.

h3_fusion_ii_vengeance.name: Vengeance Elemental
h3_fusion_ii_vengeance.narrative: Vengeance Elemental is a second-stage fused elemental, born when Fury Elemental and Wrath Elemental merge.

signatures.descriptionText: Can counterattack an unlimited number of times per round. Counterattacks deal 25% more Damage.
signatures.notes: griffin_upg Alert II (stats.numCounters 999) plus outDmgMods counter_attack +0.25, the tag that Riposte's counterattack bonus uses. The card is griffin_upg Alert II with own text.
